title: Time-harmonic (single-frequency) regime
primary_formula: steady-state at one angular frequency omega

title: Acoustic particle velocity u
primary_formula: u(x,t), fluid-element velocity due to the wave

title: Speed of sound in an ideal gas
Plane-wave solution
primary_formula: p'(x,t) = A cos(kx - omega t + phi)

title: Superposition of acoustic waves
primary_formula: the wave equation is linear ; solutions add

title: Interference of two waves
primary_formula: constructive at path-difference = n lambda ; destructive at (n+1/2) lambda

title: Standing wave
primary_formula: sum of two equal counter-propagating waves ; fixed nodes and antinodes

title: Pipe resonance, symmetric boundaries
primary_formula: f_n = n c / (2L), n=1,2,3,... (open-open or closed-closed)

title: Pipe resonance, mixed boundaries
primary_formula: f_n = (2n-1) c / (4L), n=1,2,3,... (one open, one closed end)

title: Doppler effect, moving source
primary_formula: f' = f c / (c -+ v_s), v_s << c

title: Doppler effect, moving observer
primary_formula: f' = f (c +- v_o) / c, v_o << c

title: Doppler effect, general (source and observer moving)
Acoustic reciprocity theorem
primary_formula: source and receiver may be interchanged without changing the transfer function, in any linear passive acoustic system

title: Webster horn equation
primary_formula: d/dx(S dp'/dx) + (omega/c)^2 S p' = 0, for cross-section S(x)

title: Exponential horn cutoff frequency
primary_formula: S(x) = S0 e^(2mx) ; propagates only above f_c = m c / (2 pi)
